item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure MCP Server 3.0
item.description:
Azure MCP Server 3.0 is now generally available. The release expands Azure integration for AI agents and developer tools via the open Model Context Protocol (MCP), including new infrastructure-as-code support through Azure Terraform.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Database provisioning in MSSQL extension
item.description:
Azure SQL Database provisioning in the MSSQL extension is now generally available. Users can create and connect to a managed Azure SQL Database from their editor, with ARM, Bicep, and Terraform templates included.

  • Source: Azure Updates
